title: Rabbi Chila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman reports that Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot cite Rabbi Chila in Rabbi Yannai’s name from the end of chapter 4 of Avodah Zarah. He calls this a scribal error because the passage has Rabbi Hila. It also cites Rabbi Yeili in Rabbi Yannai’s name, whom Hyman identifies as Rabbi Ilai, as explained in his entry.
